item.title: MessageFormat: Unicode standard for localizable message strings
item.description:
📝 The Unicode MessageFormat Standard The Unicode MessageFormat Standard is a stable part of CLDR. Unicode MessageFormat is sometimes referred to as MessageFormat 2. Individuals who are employees of Unicode Member organizations SHOULD contact their member representative.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/unicode-org/message-format-wg

item.title: Thanks a lot, AI: Hard drives are sold out for the year, says WD
item.description:
📝 " Three of these companies already have agreements with Western Digital for 2027 and even 2028. AI companies have been eating up computer hardware as industry growth accelerates. With this latest news from Western Digital, it appears the ever-increasing demands from AI companies for memory and storage will continue to grow, with no end in sight.
🔗 Read more: https://mashable.com/article/ai-hard-drive-hdd-shortages-western-digital-sold-out
